program:
def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    pedestrians = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    courtyard_area = image_patch.find("open courtyard")
    
    if not pedestrians or not courtyard_area:
        return []
    
    courtyard_center_x = sum(cp.horizontal_center for cp in courtyard_area) / len(courtyard_area)
    courtyard_center_y = sum(cp.vertical_center for cp in courtyard_area) / len(courtyard_area)
    
    pedestrian_distances = [(cp, abs(cp.horizontal_center - courtyard_center_x) + abs(cp.vertical_center - courtyard_center_y)) for cp in pedestrians]
    
    pedestrian_distances.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    
    return [pd[0] for pd in pedestrian_distances if pd[1] < 100]  # Assuming a threshold of 100 pixels for "near"
